items.headline: Wind Advisory issued September 16 at 1:15PM AKDT until September 17 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 15 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph
expected.

* WHERE...White Mountains and High Terrain South of the Yukon River.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM AKDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.areas: White Mountains and High Terrain South of the Yukon River
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued September 16 at 11:57AM AKDT until September 16 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* WHERE...Municipality of Skagway.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highest wind speeds expected between late
morning to early afternoon. Highest gusts so far today have been
around 45 mph.

items.description:

Bethel, and Kwethluk.

* WHEN...Until 100 PM AKDT Thursday.

occurring or is imminent.

items.description:
